name: @contextrocket/embed-widget
description: ContextRocket embeddable chat widget -- standalone IIFE bundle. Built once, reused; served locally from frontend/public/embed/ and (later) from cdn.contextrocket.com (cr-80n.151).

scripts.verify: node build.mjs && node -e "const{statSync}=require('node:fs');const p='dist/widget.js';const s=statSync(p);if(s.size<1000){console.error('widget.js too small: '+s.size+' bytes');process.exit(1)}console.log('OK '+p+' ('+s.size+' bytes)')"
